title.zh: 反应速率 · 数一数成功碰撞

desc.zh: 反应快慢取决于成功碰撞的次数：碰得越勤、能量达标的比例越大，反应越快。温度、浓度、表面积、催化剂四种提速办法，全在模拟里数给你看。
desc.en: How fast a reaction runs comes down to successful collisions: collide more often, and get more collisions over the energy bar. Temperature, concentration, surface area and catalysts — all four speed-ups, counted live in the simulation.
